verdict.rationale: Docs show Cursor's agents can inspect diffs, run checks before merge, reproduce/fix issues, and even maintain/update software via always-on agents (cursor-docs-4, 9, 12, 13), and a changelog example shows dependency version updates. However, no direct evidence explicitly confirms lint-error fixing or merge-conflict resolution as named capabilities, and community feedback raises concerns about product reliability/bugginess that could affect trust in autonomous fixes.
